recent: UEM Sunrise 近期与 AME Elite 组成联营公司，开发 Gerbang Nusajaya 综合工业园，并拟出售约 402.106 英亩土地，代价约 RM972.1 million。公司已全额收到 KLCC 开发权的 RM415.0 million 保证权益金，并正式推出发展总值 RM1.17 billion 的 MAIA Mont'Kiara 项目，开售前取得 60% 认购率。最新季度（2026年6月30日止）营收与净利均较上季及去年同期增长。
notable: 与 AME Development 签署股东协议，成立 50:50 联营公司，开发 Gerbang Nusajaya 综合工业园，并拟以 RM972.1 million 出售约 402.106 英亩土地。

recent_en: UEM Sunrise recently formed a joint venture with AME Elite to develop an integrated managed industrial park in Gerbang Nusajaya and proposed to dispose of approximately 402.106 acres of land for about RM972.1 million. The company has received the full RM415.0 million guaranteed entitlement for the KLCC development rights and officially launched the RM1.17 billion GDV MAIA Mont'Kiara project with a 60% take-up rate ahead of launch. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue and net profit rose both quarter-on-quarter and year-on-year.
notable_en: Received the full RM415.0 million guaranteed entitlement under the development rights agreement for the KLCC commercial land.
Officially launched the RM1.17 billion GDV MAIA Mont'Kiara project with a 60% take-up rate ahead of launch.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM605.7 million, up 74.2% quarter-on-quarter and 36.9% year-on-year; net profit was RM46.8 million, up 189.1% quarter-on-quarter and 109.0% year-on-year; net margin was 7.7%, higher than 4.7% in the previous quarter.
